headline.queued: This deploy is queued behind another deploy.
headline.canceled: This deploy was canceled before it changed anything.
headline.superseded: A newer deploy replaced this one before it was applied.
headline.failed: The build failed, so nothing was rolled out.
headline.rolloutFailed: The build finished but the roll out failed.
headline.rolloutFailedWhy: The build finished but the roll out failed: {{reason}}
headline.staticPublished: Static site: published directly by the ingress, no container to health check.
headline.rollingOut: Build finished. Waiting for the new container to pass its first health check, {{elapsed}} so far.
headline.rollingOutNoImage: Build finished. The roll out is waiting because no container image exists for this app yet, {{elapsed}} so far.
headline.untracked: The build finished. Roll out results are only tracked for the latest deploy.
headline.untrackedImage: A pre-built image was deployed. Roll out results are only tracked for the latest deploy.

next.queued: It starts automatically when the deploy ahead of it finishes.
next.held: Release it from the deploy history, or wait for the freeze window to end.
next.building: When the build succeeds, the new container starts and must pass its health check before it receives traffic.
next.buildingStatic: When the build succeeds, the output is published directly. No container is started.
next.failed: Open the Build tab to read the failing step, fix it, then deploy again.
next.rolloutFailed: The previous version keeps serving. Check the container logs and the health path, then redeploy or roll back.
next.rollingOut: Once the health check passes, traffic cuts over and the old container is removed.
next.staticPublished: Nothing else to wait for. Visit the site to confirm the new files are served.

mismatch.buildOkRolloutPending: The build finished, but the roll out has not completed. The build status and the roll out status are tracked separately, so both are true at once.
mismatch.buildOkRolloutFailed: The build succeeded, but the new container did not become healthy, so the previous version keeps serving.
mismatch.staticChip: The app status says "{{chip}}" because it reports container readiness. A static site has no container, so that chip does not block this deploy.

stuck.title: This is taking longer than expected
stuck.noImage: The roll out has run for more than {{limit}} and the app reports that no image has been built for it. The build step produced no runnable image, so there is nothing to start.
stuck.health: The roll out has run for more than {{limit}}. The new container is probably not answering its health check, or it keeps restarting.

empty.noStepTitle: This deploy had no build step
empty.noStepBody: A pre-built image was deployed as is, so there is no build output to show.
empty.notCapturedBody: The build did not record any log lines. The deploy itself completed, so the Roll out tab shows what happened next.
empty.waitingBody: Lines appear here as soon as the builder starts writing them.

rollout.title: Roll out timeline

reason.pendingHealth: Starts once the build has produced an image.
reason.runningHealth: Waiting for the new container to pass its readiness probe before it gets traffic.
reason.runningNoImage: Cannot start: no container image exists for this app yet.
reason.pendingCutover: Starts after the health check passes.
reason.pendingCleanup: Starts after traffic has moved to the new container.
reason.donePublish: Files published directly by the ingress.
reason.skippedBuild: No build step ran for this deploy.

rollout.staticNote: Static site: published directly by the ingress, no container to health check.
rollout.noConditions: The reconciler has not reported any status for this app yet.

page.notInHistory: This deploy attempt is not in this app's current history.
